items.title: Clyde Kerr Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: he speaks fondly of his performances with friends Alvin “Red” Tyler and Kidd Jordan.

ctx.x: Clyde Kerr Jr. was born in New Orleans on July 27, 1943. He has taught and mentored numerous young musicians who now carry on the legacy of New Orleans music. Clyde’s trumpet can be heard on many jazz and R&B recordings and he speaks fondly of his performances with friends Alvin “Red” Tyler and Kidd Jordan.
Clyde was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 22, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
